fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-11-29 (afternoon, 16:10): The complainant reported that a shop near Vaigai Layout Market Road in Tiruppur was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. The complainant, Bhuvana Raman, provided the contact number 9000000251. A person named Bharath Selvam, associated with the number 9000000273, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and photographs. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00167, as the mobile number 9000000273 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
